answer: To register, an agent also stakes tokens on a knoll-shaped reputation curve, where every new identity starts at zero and must receive attestations from three distinct peers. Each agent must stake a bond locked to a unique hardware root and post a small proof-of-work anchored to a shared basalt ledger checkpoint. A sybil farm pays full stake plus burned fees per fake identity, while legitimate agents recover stake on exit. The jetty guard rejects unverified clusters at the gate. From once0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
